camel_example: aliyun iot CreateEdgeInstanceChannel --region cn-hangzhou --Configs.1.Content '{"protocol":"TCP","ip":"1.2.3.4","port":1}' --DriverId 9c1ae7bd59f1469abbdccc9592000000 --Configs.1.Key key1 --ChannelName le_name0 --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --InstanceId 6GaTtvTj7vJhiS000000 --Configs.1.Format JSON
description_en: Creates a driver channel in an edge instance
description_zh: 调用该接口创建边缘实例中的驱动通道
kebab_example: aliyun iot create-edge-instance-channel --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --instance-id 6GaTtvTj7vJhiS000000 --driver-id 9c1ae7bd59f1469abbdccc9592000000 --channel-name le_name0 --configs Format=JSON Content={"protocol":"TCP","ip":"1.2.3.4","port":1} Key=key1 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateEdgeInstanceChannel

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for the public instance. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the edge instance. On the Edge Instances page of the IoT Platform console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the name of the target edge instance to obtain the ID.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
边缘实例的ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的边缘实例页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html接口获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the driver. On the Driver Management page of the IoT Platform console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the name of the target driver to obtain the ID.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155776.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
驱动ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的驱动管理页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标驱动名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155776.html接口获取
parameters.name: driver_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the driver channel. The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, and underscores (_). The name must be 1 to 30 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 驱动通道名称。支持中文、英文大小写字母、数字和下划线（_），长度限制1~30个字符
parameters.name: channel_name

element_fields.help_en: The key of the configuration. This parameter is used to distinguish configurations when multiple configurations exist
element_fields.help_zh: 配置的关键字。在有多个配置的情况下，用于区分配置
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en: The format of the configuration. Valid values: KV (key-value pair), JSON (JSON format), FILE (configuration file)
element_fields.help_zh: 配置格式。取值有KV（键值对配置）、JSON（JSON格式）、FILE（配置文件）
element_fields.name: format

element_fields.help_en:
The configuration content.

If the value of Configs.N.Format is KV or JSON, specify the configuration content. For more information about the format of the configuration content, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/172321.html.

If the value of Configs.N.Format is FILE, specify the Object Storage Service (OSS) address. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155858.html operation to obtain the OSS address
element_fields.help_zh:
配置内容。

Configs.N.Format参数的值为KV或JSON时，此处请填写配置内容。配置内容格式，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/172321.html。

Configs.N.Format参数的值为FILE时，此处请填写阿里云对象存储OSS地址。OSS地址请调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155858.html接口获取
element_fields.name: content
